About

Water Engineering meets Data Science

I am a water resources researcher and hydroinformatics scientist with over a decade of experience developing AI/ML and deep learning solutions for hydrological, water quality, and climate risk applications. My work sits at the intersection of data science and water engineering — combining machine learning, physically-based modelling, and remote sensing to understand and predict how freshwater systems behave under climate variability and human pressure.

Currently, I work as a Junior Scientist at the Euro-Mediterranean Center on Climate Change (CMCC) in Venice, where I contribute to multiple EU HORIZON-funded projects including CLIMAAX, ASPECT, TRANSCEND, and TALANOA-WATER. I also serve as Adjunct Professor at Ca' Foscari University of Venice.

I am passionate about problems where AI meets physical science — where the goal is not just accurate prediction but genuine understanding of complex environmental systems.

Research Focus

What I Work On

My research integrates AI/ML, physical modelling, and Earth observation to address water security challenges under climate change. I develop tools and models that work at the intersection of computation and environmental science.

🌊
Hydrological Modelling & Flood Risk
Process-based and ML-hybrid models for streamflow, flood routing, and extreme event analysis. GEV and non-stationary frequency analysis under CMIP6 projections.
🧪
Water Quality & Ecohydrology
GNN-based water quality prediction integrating sensor and satellite data. First flush dynamics in urban catchments. Remote sensing for wetland and river water quality monitoring.
🤖
AI/ML for Water Engineering
XGBoost, LSTM, Graph Neural Networks, stacking ensembles for hydrological prediction. Lead author of a Highly Cited systematic review of XGBoost in water resources engineering.
🌡️
Climate Risk Assessment
Bias correction and uncertainty quantification of CMIP6 climate projections. Drought index calculation and trend analysis. Operational risk tools for regional water authorities.
🛰️
Remote Sensing & Earth Observation
Google Earth Engine pipelines for large-scale environmental monitoring. Satellite-based snow density estimation, soil moisture, and hydro-climate variable retrieval.
💧
Water Supply & Distribution
Water distribution network analysis, DMA design, anomaly detection and demand forecasting for smart water utilities. EPANET-based hydraulic modelling.
